title: DATE ( 2008, 0, 2 ) is December 2, 2007: month 0 is the month before January

source.quote: If Month is 0 or negative, DATE goes back from January of Year by the magnitude of Month plus one month.
source.supports: DAX Guide gives DATE ( 2008, 0, 2 ) returning December 2, 2007

source.quote: Negative integers are not supported. Valid values are 1-12.
source.supports: Microsoft Learn calls only 1 to 12 valid and says nothing about 0

derivation: DAX Guide states the result outright: month 0 goes back one month from January 2008, to December 2, 2007. Microsoft Learn does not document month 0.
alternative: If the engine rejects a month outside 1 to 12 that is not above 12, as the Microsoft Learn wording could be read, the query fails.
